title: MCPA Training Question
description: Schema for quiz questions in the MCPA Training Bot, revised 2026-09-11 to match the curated v2 bank. Single-select items ('mcq', 'scenario', 'true-false') carry exactly one 'answer' letter and 4 options; multiple-select items ('multi_select', 'mcq-multi') carry an 'answers' array of 2-3 letters and 5 options. Chapters run 1-17, matching the 17 question files.

id.description: Unique question identifier: 'ch<chapter>-q<n>' for single-select, 'ch<chapter>-m<n>' for multiple-select

type.description: 'mcq', 'scenario' and 'true-false' are single-select; 'multi_select' and 'mcq-multi' are multiple-select

question.description: The question stem. Curated items state a situation and ask for a decision rather than quoting specification prose.

options.description: Answer options: 4 (A-D) for single-select, 5 (A-E) for multiple-select

answer.description: Correct answer letter for single-select questions

answers.description: Correct answer letters for multiple-select questions, e.g. ['A','C','E']. Never all of the options.

explanation.description: Why the key is correct and why the most tempting distractor is not

domain.description: MCPA exam domain this item is scored against

source.description: Path of the primary source the item was written from, e.g. 'specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization'

protocolVersion.description: Protocol revision the item is valid for
